result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an untranslated localization key visible to the user.

issues.description: The section title 'home_feed.popular_title' is a raw localization key that has not been resolved to a human-readable string. It is displayed literally on screen instead of the intended translated label (e.g. 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization/i18n system correctly maps the key 'home_feed.popular_title' to the appropriate translated string for the user's locale before rendering the UI.
